jobs.title: Commercial Sales Manager - Japan
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


What you’ll do 
 
The APAC Sales team is looking for a highly motivated Sales Commercial Manager who is excited at the idea of selling a disruptive technology solution in the commodities market, maintaining and building on clients’ relationships through renewals, upsells, and cross-sells!
 
More specifically you will:
 
•Make daily contact with clients by email, chats, and most importantly by phone. We want someone who is not afraid of cold-calling
•Setting up meetings, interacting with senior decision-makers, following up on trials, and troubleshooting queries
•Maintaining accurate customer and sales information in our internal CRM
•Build relationships with your clients by partnering with the Customer Success team, identifying and closing up-sell opportunities, and cross-sell
•Help and collaborate with the rest of the Sales team: we are looking for someone with a great drive and team spirit, who can multi-task and offer solutions!
 
 
You are or have...
 
•+5 years of experience in Sales roles in SaaS or DaaS environments (within Energy/Maritime/Commodities)
• Japanese native and fluent English
•Excellent oral presentation skills, as well as a deep knowledge of the local culture
• Excellent customer service, listening, and negotiation skills
• Ability to operate in a high-growth fast-paced environment. Experience in start-up and/or fast-growing companies is a strong plus
•Enthusiastic team player with strong analytical skills
 
 

We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?
 
We make things happen
We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
 
We build together
We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
 
We are here to help
We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
 
 
Our People Pledge
 
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager  Houston - US)
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) focused on energy clients across Canada and the United States, you will own and manage a portfolio of clients, driving high levels of adoption, engagement, and retention. You’ll act as a trusted advisor and advocate, helping clients maximize the value of Kpler’s commodity and maritime intelligence intelligence solutions. By building strong client partnerships and understanding their operational needs, you’ll ensure meaningful engagement with Kpler while identifying opportunities to deepen adoption and deliver long-term value.

Responsibilities 
- Build and nurture strong, proactive relationships with clients across the North American region, acting as a trusted partner throughout the customer lifecycle.

- Deliver seamless onboarding experiences, ensuring clients are effectively set up and positioned to realise value from Kpler’s solutions.

- Develop and execute tailored client engagement strategies to drive adoption, improve user experience, and maximise platform utilisation.

- Provide expert support across email, calls, and in-person meetings, becoming a trusted point of contact for client questions relating to maritime data, workflows, and platform capabilities.

- Monitor client usage, engagement, and business outcomes, proactively identifying opportunities to better align Kpler’s solutions with client objectives, including voyage planning, competitive analysis, and risk mitigation.

- Partner closely with Sales to identify expansion opportunities, support renewals, and demonstrate client value through data-driven impact narratives.

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to communicate client feedback, identify recurring needs, and help translate insights into actionable product improvements.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in Salesforce, including engagement plans, success metrics, opportunities, and renewal risks.

- Proactively identify and address risks to client satisfaction, adoption, and retention, escalating issues where appropriate and coordinating cross-functional resolution.

- Share customer insights, market trends, and recurring use cases internally to help inform product development, commercial strategy, and broader customer success initiatives.
Skills and Experience
- 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role, ideally within oil and gas, energy, commodities, data, SaaS, or DaaS.

- Strong understanding of energy research workflows, industry stakeholders, and commodity tracking data , with the ability to confidently discuss data and analytics topics with clients.

- Proven experience managing a diverse book of business across accounts of varying complexity, driving adoption, engagement, retention, and measurable customer outcomes.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills —empathetic, attentive, and client-first, with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients.

- Highly organised and self-motivated , with a knack for understanding client needs, translating them into actionable plans, and proactively identifying opportunities to add value.

- Customer-centric and product-oriented , with a strong understanding of how to connect client objectives with product capabilities and drive meaningful adoption.

- Technically competent , with familiarity with data platforms, Excel, APIs, Python, and CRM systems such as Salesforce.

- Curious and ambitious , with a desire to continuously learn, challenge the status quo, and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience.

- Collaborative and adaptable , comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams in a fast-paced, global environment.

jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As an Enterprise Account Manager for Supply Chain & Logistics, you will drive Kpler’s strategic expansion across our highest-value global enterprise accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives and senior stakeholders, helping complex global organizations solve critical trade and supply chain challenges using our market-leading data and SaaS analytics platforms. By orchestrating multi-threaded account strategies and leading high-stakes commercial negotiations, you will unlock significant net retention and long-term revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities
-
Drive Strategic Enterprise Growth: Proactively manage, retain, and expand multi-threaded relationships across key enterprise accounts to maximize net retention and long-term client value.

-
Execute Account Growth Plans: Take ownership of comprehensive strategic account plans, combining SWOT analysis, stakeholder mapping, and whitespace identification to align Kpler's solutions with client growth priorities.

-
Engage C-Suite Decision-Makers: Initiate and lead consultative discussions with C-level executives, VPs, and economic buyers to uncover complex operational challenges and articulate clear ROI.

-
Negotiate Complex Commercial Terms: Formulate commercial strategies and negotiate six-figure, multi-year renewal and expansion agreements that secure long-term, profitable relationships.

-
Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Collaborate with Product, Market Analysts, Customer Success, Account Development Representatives (ADRs), and Sales Specialists to transform usage insights into expansion opportunities.

-
Maintain CRM Integrity & Market Insights: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting in Salesforce while capturing client intelligence to directly influence Kpler’s product roadmap.
Experience & Background
-
5+ years of B2B commercial experience successfully selling data, analytics, or SaaS platforms with a verifiable track record of quota achievement.

-
Demonstrated history of accessing, negotiating with, and closing complex deals directly with VP and C-level economic buyers in enterprise organizations.

-
Deep expertise in strategic account management, including executing six-figure multi-year contracts and balancing long-term positioning with short-term targets.

-
Proven hunter mentality with a strong track record of closing expansion revenue through cross-selling, upselling, and penetrating new business units or subsidiaries.

Nice-to-haves:

-
Direct industry background or domain exposure in supply chain, maritime, manufacturing, or enterprise technology sectors.

-
Extensive experience leveraging Salesforce CRM for sales forecasting and pipeline management.

About the Role
As Kpler continues to expand across the APAC region, building a high-performing partner network is pivotal to scaling our global footprint. In this role, you will lead the strategic identification, enablement, and growth of key channel partners, turning market insights into shared revenue opportunities. Reporting directly to the Director of APAC, you will serve as the commercial bridge between partner ecosystems and Kpler's internal teams, driving long-term value in energy, commodities, and maritime intelligence.
 

Key Responsibilities
-
Build & Expand Partner Networks: Recruit, onboard, and develop high-potential channel partners across key APAC markets to accelerate business growth.

-
Drive Joint Go-to-Market Strategies: Establish collaborative business plans, revenue targets, and co-selling initiatives aligned with regional business goals.

-
Enable Partner Success: Deliver high-impact sales enablement, product training, and go-to-market resources to build partner expertise and engagement.

-
Manage Commercial Relationships: Conduct quarterly business reviews and lead contract negotiations to optimize performance and align partner activities with business strategy.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Sales teams to launch targeted partner campaigns and remove execution friction.

-
Pipeline & Revenue Ownership: Track partner-led opportunities, maintain accurate forecasts in CRM tools, and consistently hit revenue expansion metrics.
Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

-
5+ years of experience in channel management, strategic partnerships, or business development within B2B SaaS or technology sectors.

-
Demonstrated history of building, scaling, and managing strategic channel relationships that directly impact revenue growth.

-
Strong negotiation capabilities and solid commercial acumen for structuring partnership agreements.

-
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and enable external sales teams through targeted enablement programs.

-
Proficiency in CRM platforms (such as Salesforce or HubSpot) for pipeline tracking and partner account management.

Nice-to-haves:

-
Direct experience working within SaaS, cloud, enterprise software, telecommunications, or commodities/maritime technology sectors.

-
Familiarity with structured partner incentive models, joint marketing initiatives, and APAC regional partner ecosystems.
